composition_subtypes.role: Efficiently select and combine smallest piles
Always merge the smallest current piles, choosing 2 or 3 based on parity

payload.core_composition_summary: Use min-heap to repeatedly merge smallest 2 or 3 piles, minimizing total merge cost.
payload.rationale: Heap enables efficient extraction and insertion; greedy choice of merge count based on remaining pile parity ensures optimality.
